create_modelslim_w4a4_int4_moe: create a ModelSlimW4A4Int4MoE instance for W4A4 int4 quantized MoE layers on NPU
create_weights_moe_layer: create int8 weights and float32 scales and offsets for a quantized MoE layer with given expert and hidden sizes
process_weights_after_loading: process loaded MoE layer weights through the NPU W4A4 int4 dynamic MoE kernel post-loading
create_moe_runner: create an MoE runner config for a quantized MoE layer to enable fused MoE execution
apply_weights_moe_forward: apply quantized MoE weights with dispatch output to produce combined input for MoE forward pass
